name: Enveloped in Light raises plate armor and cuts Shadow damage taken (#1376)
contract: Enveloped in Light rank 1 (680652) and rank 2 (681467) are SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE. Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_BASE_RESISTANCE_PCT (142) with EffectMiscValue SPELL_SCHOOL_MASK_NORMAL (1) and EffectMiscValueB 16 (1 << ITEM_SUBCLASS_ARMOR_PLATE); SpellEffectInfo::GetItemArmorSubclassMask() (SpellInfo.cpp) already special-cases spell ids 680652 and 681467 by name, returning mask 16 for exactly this effect, and Player::UpdateArmor (StatSystem.cpp) multiplies only GetItemArmorBySubclass(PLATE) by this modifier before adding it to total armor -- a native, already-shipped mechanism, not a side effect. EffectBasePoints 9/19 resolve to +10/+20 (percent), matching the tooltip. Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN (87) with EffectMiscValue school mask 32 (Shadow) and EffectBasePoints -4/-7 resolving to -3/-6 (percent); this is a fully generic, family-agnostic damage-taken modifier consumed wherever incoming Shadow damage is calculated, with no script needed.
